external-link.context: Square with an arrow breaking out of its top right corner. Used for links that open in a new tab or window, leave the current site or open another app.

home.context: House with a pitched roof and a door in the middle. Used for home buttons, the main page, dashboards, start screens, home addresses and real estate listings.

menu.context: Three horizontal lines of equal length stacked evenly. Used to open navigation menus, side drawers, app menus, more options on mobile and list views.
